description: In early December, Arcadia Mayor April Verlato announced her campaign on a heartfelt and dedicated mission as she pioneers her run for the Congressional seat in California’s 28th District. As the first mayor to challenge incumbent Rep. Judy Chu, Verlato’s decision to run is a poignant response to the overlooked yet pressing crises facing both […]
title: April Verlato Campaigns for Seat in Congress - April Verlato for Congress
